title: Harness task node
description: One node in the build graph. Lives as YAML frontmatter in harness/graph/<id>.md; the markdown body is the brief the agent reads.

id.description: Unique kebab-case id. Must match the filename.

phase.description: Coarse grouping shown in `status` (scaffold, content, design, deploy, … — any names). Ordering comes from depends_on, not from phase.

status.description: doing is a lock: at most one task may be 'doing' at a time. dropped = superseded by a change of direction: terminal, but NOT done — nothing may depend on a dropped task, and notes must say what replaced it.

owner.description: human = a gate the loop cannot pass (credentials, sign-ups, money, taste, DNS). The loop skips these and reports them.

depends_on.description: Task ids that must be 'done' first. Edges of the DAG; cycles are a validation error.

priority.description: Tie-breaker among ready tasks. 1 is most important.

acceptance.description: Observable conditions. Each must be checkable by a human reading the diff, or by 'verify'.

verify.description: Shell command that must exit 0 for this task. Runs in the repo root.

artifacts.description: Paths this task is expected to create or change. Used to spot tasks that claim done but touched nothing.

spec.description: Path to the spec section this task implements. Tasks without a spec tend to drift.

notes.description: Discoveries from the attempt: why it was harder than expected, what the next task needs to know.
